If you've been missing the ability to quickly double-press the Digital Crown on Apple Watch to bring up the App Switcher—a feature that existed before watchOS 27—good news: it looks like this functionality is making a comeback in watchOS 27.2 beta 2. Details below.

Apple is working on bringing back the App Switcher in watchOS

Apple rolled out watchOS 27.2 beta 2 to developers this morning, less than a week after the previous beta 1 release.

There's a detail in this beta version that's sure to please a group of long-time Apple Watch users (including my colleague Zac Hall). Earlier this month, he wrote about how watchOS 27 removed the ability to switch between recently used apps by quickly double-pressing the Digital Crown.

In his article, he pointed out that users can no longer quickly jump between recent apps, and expressed hope that Apple would restore this gesture either before watchOS 27's official release or in a future update.

Although Apple hasn't restored that Digital Crown shortcut gesture in this watchOS 27.2 beta 2 test version, it has brought back the App Switcher functionality through a new gesture.

According to a member of the Apple Den Discord server, shared by user Bones on X, watchOS 27.2 beta 2 lets users bring up the App Switcher by long-pressing the bottom of the screen while using an app.

As Bones noted in his post, the other App Switcher operations are pretty much the same as before: after long-pressing the bottom of the screen to bring up the switcher, users can rotate the Digital Crown to scroll through recently used apps, or swipe left on an app and tap the "X" button to remove it from the switcher.

As with any beta version, this gesture might not necessarily make it into the final release (expected next month), but the fact that it's showing up in watchOS 27.2 beta 2 at least shows that Apple is listening to user feedback and is working on bringing the App Switcher feature back.

Have you been missing the App Switcher on watchOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
